Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(Chapter 275, Section 11(3))
Order under Section 11(3)
O 20
G.N. No. S 333/1999
REVISED EDITION 2001
(31st January 2001)
[1st August 1999]
Whereas pursuant to section 10 of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have published in loose-leaf form the Acts set out in the Schedule as in force on 16th July 1999:
And Whereas it is provided under section 11(3) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act that the Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of each of the loose-leaf edition of these Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, specify that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, in all courts and for all purposes, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts:
Now therefore it is hereby ordered by the President that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, with effect from 1st August 1999, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts.

THE SCHEDULE
(1) The Interpretation Act (Chapter 1)
(2) The Accountants Act (Chapter 2A)
(3) The Administration of Muslim Law Act (Chapter 3)
(4) The Audit Act (Chapter 17)
(5) The Betting and Sweepstake Duties Act (Chapter 22)
(6) The Bills of Exchange Act (Chapter 23)
(7) The Civil Law Act (Chapter 43)
(8) The Control of Plants Act (Chapter 57A)
(9) The Currency Act (Chapter 69)
(10) The Dangerous Fireworks Act (Chapter 72)
(11) The Environmental Public Health Act (Chapter 95)
(12) The Hotels Act (Chapter 127)
(13) The Industrial Relations Act (Chapter 136)
(14) The Kidnapping Act (Chapter 151)
(15) The Subordinate Courts Act (Chapter 321)
(16) The Supreme Court of Judicature Act (Chapter 322)
(17) The Trustees Act (Chapter 337)
(18) The Sale of Goods Act (Chapter 393)
(19) The Supply of Goods Act (Chapter 394)
[G.N. No. S 333/99]
